title: Prove Q8 pair and signed-triple tariffs with arbitrary dirty workspace
body:
## Summary

Prove the sharp positive-Q8 call bill for a negative-generator pair and for two negative generators plus one positive generator, with arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace.

```text
XY = P_odd
rank X + rank Y <= calls + odd_targets
restrict to im X, or quotient by ker Y
reduced roles <= floor((calls + odd_targets)/2)

negative pair: shorter word fits <=3 roles; minimum6
two-negative/one-positive triple: shorter word fits <=4 roles; minimum7
```

The new common-kernel quotient complements the credited image restriction and preserves the ordered noncommuting paid labels. It lifts PR3471's unchanged four-role exclusions to every finite dirty width, closing its explicit handoff without enlarging the census. The model has unit-priced positive i,j calls, binary rank-one idempotents, free scalar GL mixing and full coefficientwise endpoints.

Only `research/q8-workspace-reduction/` changes. Exact PR3471 source, receipt and scope bytes are retained locally, with origin heads/blobs/SHA256 and predecessor credit. No unmerged foreign Git object is required. Tuafo/PR2900 retain image-restriction credit, ywz65/PR2587 the support/Sylvester method, PR3450 the character, PR3460 the one-negative boundary, and Aaron Wang/PR2318 the two-role values. The physical compiler/caller lineage remains separate.

## Evidence

- **Before:** PR3471 certifies fixed three/four-role endpoints and leaves arbitrary restored dirty workspace open. **After:** PROOF.md supplies the uniform reduction and two sharp corollaries, with explicit image and quotient constructions.
- Exact replay checks 5,333 short words, 487 diagonal endpoints, five larger reduction fixtures, 116 direct endpoints and 792 omissions. Independent Hamilton convolution checks 64 products, 8,502 native probe states, both 42,041-state balls and pair meets. The full triple membership stream uses the retained native implementation; a second complete stream is unclaimed.
- Registered Python3.12 replay and four optimized behavioral groups pass, including actual reduction/native faults and dirty restoration. Strict C++ diagnostics, Ruff, final-head committed bytes/source history, export integrity and both actual optimized Git-free committed commands pass. All 19 exported payload/transport files retain their bytes, modes and inodes.

```sh
TMPDIR="$RUN/scratch" python3.12 -Werror -B scripts/research_package.py \
  --package research/q8-workspace-reduction
TMPDIR="$RUN/scratch" python3.12 -I -O -Werror -B \
  research/q8-workspace-reduction/verify.py
```

Create an owned `$RUN/scratch` first. Python3.12+ and a C++20 compiler are required. Canonical baseline/submission main is `6f100d4bb5083f8c35d96fd95a539811c62f245c`, priority revision6. [Canonical investigation](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2034#discussioncomment-19010336).

This is a computer-assisted scoped theorem, with no supplier, new kappa or selected-frontier change. Three-negative arbitrary-width and nonuniform-price tariffs, physical invoice, full selected cold replay and Lean remain unrun or outside scope. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way. The isolated opt-in package can be reverted.

**Blast Radius:** package. Selected sources and shared tooling are unchanged.
